title: Amethyst Age
description: Expand Minecraft's amethyst progression with new tools, armor, weapons, food, a custom biome, Crystal Merchant, Crystal Warrior boss, advancements, and unique abilities like 3×3 mining, Tree Chopper, and Crystal Charge! 💜
body:
💜 Amethyst Age

Amethyst Age is a vanilla-inspired Minecraft mod that transforms amethyst into a complete progression path. Discover powerful equipment, explore a beautiful crystal biome, meet new characters, and unlock unique abilities that expand your Minecraft adventure.

✨ Features

⚒️ New Amethyst Equipment

Craft a complete set of Amethyst Tools and Amethyst Armor.

Every tool comes with its own special ability:

⛏️ Pickaxe – Mines in a 3×3 area.
🪓 Axe – Instantly fells entire trees with Tree Chopper.
🗡️ Powerful custom weapons.
🛡️ Complete armor set with crystal-inspired design.
🔨 Amethyst Mace

A unique mace featuring the Crystal Charge ability, allowing you to dash forward in combat.

🏹 Amethyst Bow

Fire powerful crystal projectiles with the new Amethyst Bow.

🍎 New Food
💜 Amethyst Apple
🥕 Amethyst Carrot

Perfect for adventurers exploring the Crystal Grove.

💎 Amethyst Gem

A valuable crystal with unique uses throughout the mod.

🌿 Crystal Grove

Explore a brand-new Amethyst-themed biome filled with crystal decorations and exclusive resources.

⛏️ New Ore

Mine Amethyst Ore to begin your crystal adventure.

👤 New Villager

Meet the Crystal Merchant, a brand-new villager profession offering exclusive crystal trades.

👹 New Boss

Challenge the Crystal Warrior, a powerful enemy available in multiple difficulty levels.

🏆 Advancements

Unlock custom advancements as you progress through the mod.

🌟 And Much More

Amethyst Age includes many additional improvements, decorative content, sounds, particles, and quality-of-life features designed to blend seamlessly into vanilla Minecraft.

🎮 Vanilla+

The goal of Amethyst Age is to feel like an official Minecraft update by expanding one of Minecraft's most underused materials: Amethyst.
